description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Smarty_CacheResource_Mysql' that implements a caching resource for Smarty templating engine using a MySQL database. It includes methods for fetching, saving, and deleting cache entries, and manages database interactions via PDO.

classes.name: Smarty_CacheResource_Mysql
classes.description: Implements cache operations (fetch, save, delete) using MySQL via PDO for Smarty template caching.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the database connection and prepares SQL statements.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Retrieves cached content and its modification time from the database.

methods.name: fetchTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the modification timestamp of the cached content.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Stores cache content into the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes cache entries based on provided filters or clears the entire cache.
